issue_request: FHIR-12472 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 change request asking the Common Use Cases XDS section to add a DocumentManifest bullet describing documents grouped in original publication and to link MHD to the IHE wiki page.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 11396, represented by git commit bbe4bdfc609867456934f27b088a3ae489a415d5, which added the DocumentManifest bullet to source/usecases.html.
additional_context: FHIR-36884 was a later Published/Persuasive R5 issue for the same XDS use-case section. Its applied source change replaced the outdated DocumentManifest wording with List, added current IHE MHD/MHDS links, and the current fhir.ini indicates DocumentManifest is not an active resource and redirects to List.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Restoring the literal DSTU2 DocumentManifest bullet or old IHE wiki link would conflict with later approved source and the current resource set.
